children: November 17 (Renewables Now) - Japanese battery systems maker PowerX Inc
has supplied a single unit of its Mega Power 2700A battery energy storage system (BESS) with a rated capacity of 2,468 kWh to a subsidiary of trading company Toyota Tsusho Corp
The BESS unit will deployed at the Miyagi Taiwa Plant of Toyota Motor East Japan Inc (TMEJ) in Miyagi Prefecture, PowerX said.

In addition to helping stabilise the supply-demand balance in the Tohoku area, the BESS will also be used for peak shaving of the plant's power usage, for shifting power purchases to lower-cost hours, and for making use of surplus electricity from adjacent solar parks.
The system, selected to receive a subsidy from the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), is scheduled to commence operations in fiscal year 2027.
PowerX noted that this is its second product deployment at a TMEJ site, following the Kanegasaki Resilience Grid community microgrid in April 2026.

title: PowerX to deliver BESS equipment for Toyota Tsusho in Japan
